reason: I'd screenshot that paper cloud pendant, run it through Google Lens and find a near-identical one on Amazon or Wayfair for a lot less, and I already have Prime. Sixty reviews on a store I've never heard of isn't enough for me to pay a premium over a lookalike I can get in two days.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and for $249 I can't tell what I'm getting over the $90 version on Amazon that looks the same.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it's a different product from the Amazon lookalikes (not the same factory item rebranded), plus a cheap sample or swatch I can hold, or a trade price that gets it close to Amazon pricing.
